# Project Kickoff Meeting - Q4 Initiative

- **Project:** Content Management System Refactor
- **Facilitated by:** Engineering Director
- **Attendees:** Backend Lead, Frontend Lead, DevOps Engineer, Product Manager
- **Objective:** Align on technical approach and timeline for CMS migration to microservices

## Key Decisions

1. Primary focus will be on API layer optimization and database schema redesign.
2. Frontend team will prepare component library migration plan by October 22nd.
3. DevOps will establish staging environment with Docker containers within the first week.

## Action Items

- [ ] Engineering Director will finalize technical architecture documentation by end of week.
- [ ] Backend Lead will create migration strategy for existing data (estimated impact: 50GB).
- [ ] Frontend Lead will conduct compatibility assessment with current UI framework (React 19).

## Critical Path & Dependencies

- Database migration must complete before API deployment (3-week buffer).
- Component library refactor blocks 4 other product initiatives.

## Next Steps

- Technical sync scheduled for October 18th at 14:00 UTC.
- Architecture review with stakeholders on October 21st.
